snippet.title: ITER-8 Trailer | New Steam Demo!
snippet.description:
Welcome to ITER-8
Where failure is expected, survival is optional, and corporate loyalty is mandatory™.

You are Operator #8. The eighth of… well, let’s not get caught up in numbers. You’ve been “randomly” selected by the ITER Corporation to descend into the great unknown, extract precious resources, and probably explode in the line of duty. But don’t worry, we’ve already got Operator #9 on standby. With better posture.

Mine. Defend. Upgrade. Explode. Repeat.
Crack open planetary Pillars, defend company property with your life (literally), and upgrade your tools so the next version of you can last 12% longer.

PLAY THE DEMO
Your first descent is on us!
Wishlist & Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832310/ITER/

REPORT TO HQ
🐦| https://x.com/fluckyMachine
🦋| https://bsky.app/profile/fluckymachine.bsky.social
🎮| https://discord.gg/tw578AuhNH

WARNING
Death, dismemberment, existential horror, and light paperwork may occur during gameplay. By engaging with this product, you waive your right to complain about any of the above. Thank you for serving the greater corporate vision.
